title: Tadoba
subtitle: Jungle Safari · Wildlife · Tiger Reserve
inclusions: To & Fro SL Train Tickets (3AC upgrade available)

itinerary.title: Board Train from Mumbai
itinerary.description: 01 May 2026 (Friday) — Reporting Station: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT). Board the train for Nagpur. Overnight train journey.

itinerary.title: Reach Nagpur & Transfer to Resort
itinerary.description: 02 May 2026 (Saturday) — Reach Nagpur by morning. Check in at hotel/resort. Freshen up. Enjoy breakfast. Afternoon jungle safari at Tadoba Tiger Reserve. Return to resort. Dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Jungle Safari Day
itinerary.description: 03 May 2026 (Sunday) — Early morning jungle safari (best time for wildlife spotting). Return to resort for breakfast. Second safari in the afternoon. Free time to relax at the resort. Dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Return to Nagpur & Board Train
itinerary.description: 04 May 2026 (Monday) — Breakfast. Check out from resort. Last morning safari at Tadoba. Return to Nagpur. Board return train for Mumbai. Overnight journey.

itinerary.title: Reach Mumbai
itinerary.description: 05 May 2026 (Tuesday) — Reach Mumbai by approximately 6:45 AM. Return home with sweet memories!

advisory: Carry binoculars for wildlife viewing. Wear neutral-colored clothing. Follow all jungle safari rules strictly.
